name: codesentinel
description: Local-first code security review with plain-language explanations and a comprehension gate.

codesentinel.pythonPath.description: Interpreter used to run `python -m codesentinel`. Point this at the interpreter of the environment where CodeSentinel is installed (for example a conda env).

codesentinel.scanOnSave.description: Scan a supported file every time it is saved.

codesentinel.showAdvisories.description: Show advisory heuristics as Hints. Advisories are guesses about something absent and never fail a build.

codesentinel.showFix.description: Show fixes inline without answering the comprehension question first. Off by default - the gate is the point.

codesentinel.gutterIcons.description: Highlight lines with findings in the editor.

enumDescriptions: Show CodeSentinel's own inline message unless Error Lens is installed and enabled, in which case leave the line to Error Lens.
Always show CodeSentinel's own inline message.
Never show it. Findings still appear as squiggles, in the Problems panel and on hover.
codesentinel.inlineMessage.description: Render a one-line summary of each finding at the end of the line. The full explanation, the attack and the fix stay on hover - a line of code is no place for four paragraphs.

codesentinel.inlineMessageMaxLength.description: Longest inline message before the title is shortened. The severity and the rule id are never cut.

codesentinel.timeoutMs.description: How long to wait for a scan before giving up.

codesentinel.minSeverity.description: Lowest severity to show as a diagnostic. Advisories are controlled separately by codesentinel.showAdvisories.
